interface.longDescription: Find grants, subsidies and public funding in Spain for businesses, autónomos, associations and research projects. Search the official BDNS database by topic and compare published beneficiary categories, application dates and source links. Review up to five records per page and continue through further pages. Check the current call and its rules before applying: a listed record can be historical or a direct award. The connector searches public records; it does not submit applications or guarantee funding.
